signal: Role-level hypothesis: as a fractional RevOps lead at Carefeed, a senior-care communication SaaS, scaling pipeline coverage across skilled nursing and senior living without adding headcount is the core constraint

email.body1:
Amy, running RevOps fractionally for Carefeed, you are likely covering skilled nursing and senior living pipeline with a lean team.

That usually means more in-market accounts than the team can route and act on before signals go stale. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Carefeed off your hiring and tech-stack data, and accounts showing those signals tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Amy, quick follow-up for Carefeed.

For a fractional RevOps lead, the real drag is latency: signals fire, but nobody touches them fast enough, so pipeline that should convert decays in the queue. That gap usually shows up late, after a quarter is already at risk.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change, and our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Amy, last bit of proof for Carefeed.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Carefeed's reply rate likely compares to other healthcare SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Amy, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running RevOps fractionally is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Carefeed either way.
